Simpsonの推定値は厳密誤差上界ではありません。盲点の検出に合格しても積分精度への合格ではありません。平方根の直接積分は深さ予算で未収束と表示し得ます。任意の振動・特異性の完全な探索や認証付き求積は主張しません。 文献への入口 Calculation of Gauss quadrature rules (1969) QUADPACK: A Subroutine Package for Scope and remaining work Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: The Simpson estimate is not a certified error bound. Passing the blind-spot control does not mean accurate integration. Direct square-root integration may honestly terminate at its depth budget. Exhaustive oscillatory/singular exploration and certified quadrature are not claimed.
